label: Documented and expanded Taymuriyya’s feminist intellectual precedent into encyclopedic history
description: Fawwaz included Taymuriyya in Al-Durr al-Manthur, constructing a systematic counter-archive proving women’s historical leadership across civilizations.
dialecticalTension: Moves from moral treatise to empirical feminist counter-historiography.

citations.author: Zaynab Fawwaz
citations.work: Al-Durr al-Manthur fi Tabaqat Rabbat al-Khudur

label: Articulated equal educational and civic rights foundational to Egypt’s organized feminist movement
description: Fawwaz’s polemics in Cairo newspapers demanding women’s public work and legal autonomy directly preceded Sha’arawi’s Egyptian Feminist Union.
dialecticalTension: Links 19th-century print-public feminism to 20th-century political mobilization.
